jobs.title: Chargé de soutien aux programmes et à l'administration
jobs.description: Cette mission de 5 mois soutient la coordination, l'administration et le suivi des projets internationaux et des activités des parties prenantes dans un environnement multiculturel. Le rôle combine le soutien aux projets, la recherche, la rédaction de rapports, la coordination d'événements et les responsabilités administratives tout en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec un large éventail de partenaires internes et externes. Effectuer des recherches et compiler des informations de fond pour les projets et initiatives. Soutenir la coordination et le suivi des programmes, projets et activités des parties prenantes. Surveiller les échéances, points d'action et livrables des projets. Organiser des réunions, ateliers et événements, y compris la logistique et la documentation. Tenir à jour les dossiers, bases de données, listes de contacts et systèmes de gestion documentaire. Assister dans le reporting d'avancement, le suivi budgétaire et les activités de planification des programmes. Assurer la liaison avec les équipes internes, partenaires externes et parties prenantes clés. Préparer des synthèses, analyses et rapports de gestion. Fournir un soutien administratif et de coordination quotidien à la haute direction. Profil Licence en droit, économie, relations internationales, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe. Minimum 6 ans d'expérience pertinente en soutien de projet, coordination de programme, administration ou opérations. Solides compétences analytiques, de recherche et de rédaction de rapports. Excellentes compétences organisationnelles avec la capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités. Expérience dans la préparation de rapports professionnels, présentations et documents de briefing. Grande attention aux détails et capacités de gestion de l'information. Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et en gestion des parties prenantes. Maîtrise écrite et orale de l'anglais et du français. La connaissance de l'arabe serait un atout important. Connaissance avancée des outils Microsoft Office et des plateformes collaboratives. Offre d'emploi Exposition à des projets internationaux et à des parties prenantes de haut niveau. Environnement de travail dynamique, multiculturel et collaboratif. Responsabilités variées combinant coordination, administration et soutien aux projets. Opportunité de contribuer à des initiatives régionales à fort impact.

Both operational and strategic, you maintain a global vision of the projects at all times and actively contribute to their success. Your profile Reliable, committed and pragmatic, you have a strong sense of responsibility and are recognised for your ability to advance projects. Your listening skills, interpersonal ease and architectural sensitivity allow you to understand the expectations of your interlocutors and to unite partners with diverse interests. Holder of a higher education degree in architecture, engineering or an equivalent field, you have acquired confirmed experience in managing construction projects in Switzerland. Ideally with a background in AMO, RMO or a comparable role, you master the Swiss construction environment, its stakeholders, processes and administrative procedures.

At the same time, you feel at home in the marketing world and are motivated to work in a dynamic environment focused on business software solutions. You remain calm even when several projects run simultaneously. Fluent German is a given for you, as clear communication is worth its weight in gold. And what you get out of it: A job that is guaranteed not to be boring: with a clear focus on events, you shape a lot and get the freedom to make your ideas big. A team that supports you and a team spirit that has already received five stars on Kununu. From zero to one hundred in 19… no, not seconds, years. We are fast but have grown healthily and are well organised. Yet something is still like in our beginnings: the structures are lean and you easily find the right contacts. Once you have settled into the job, exciting development opportunities await you. A good salary that you can help determine with your performance. Daily sickness benefits and accident insurance? jobs.title: Sous Chef Event & Catering Kitchen (m/f/d) 100%
jobs.description: Fancy gastronomy with adrenaline? Forget dusty gastro standards: At Ullrich Hospitality AG based in Arlesheim BL, we create experiences that stay in the memory! As one of the leading event catering companies in Switzerland, we bring unique concepts to life - from stylish galas and exclusive corporate events to thundering large-scale events with up to 6,500 guests and cool street food projects. Whether in our own event locations or on site with our clients. We combine the strength of a market leader with the freedom and dynamism of a modern lifestyle company. With us, you won’t find a rigid routine but a young, ambitious team with a genuine hands-on mentality: We support each other, think differently and deliver top performance where the celebrations happen. Are you looking for a place where you can fully invest your energy, actively shape things and grow beyond yourself together with us? Welcome to the world of Ullrich! Ullrich Hospitality is part of Ullrich Enterprise AG . Under its umbrella, two other companies operate. Besides the event sector, we are also strong in back office: Ullrich Treuhand GmbH manages mandates from various industries and ensures order and clarity - from financial accounting to controlling and human resources. Ullrich Konzepte GmbH acts as a strategic driver, supports companies in business development and develops innovative gastro concepts that go far beyond the ordinary. Do you want not only to stand at the stove but actively shape the culinary future of the Swiss event industry? In our kitchen, you won’t find dusty routine: We tinker with innovative food concepts, rock the biggest events in the country together and create moments that remain memorable. You are a sous chef personality with pronounced leadership, organisational and executive experience, have deep gourmet understanding and are looking for a real key role as the right hand of our chef de cuisine - and all that without tedious curfews? Then you are exactly right at Ullrich Hospitality! As Sous Chef (m/f/d) 100% , you form a strong leadership duo together with a second sous chef directly alongside our chef de cuisine. You take co-responsibility for the operational kitchen management, administrative planning and leadership of our core team as well as the variable seasonal crew. Your tasks with us: Right hand of the chef de cuisine: You actively support our head chef in planning, organisation and concept development. In his absence, you take overall leadership as deputy of the head chef. Operational support & team guidance : You work closely with the head chef and the second sous chef. Together you lead our fixed core team of 6 employees (including 2 apprentices) in catering production and at event assignments. Flexible seasonal team : Depending on the season, event volume and workload, you get more involved in operational business and ensure the training and guidance of our variable employees. Quality & gourmet feeling: You ensure that every dish - from exclusive business caterings to impressive large-scale events - meets the highest gourmet standards in taste and appearance. Planning & admin: You have administrative processes under control (duty planning, production planning, recipe standardisation, compliance with HACCP and hygiene guidelines, etc.) and ensure structured workflows on site. Event & catering assignments: You actively assist at caterings and events throughout Switzerland - in our own locations and on site with our clients. Requirements Training & experience: Completed training as a cook EFZ as well as solid experience in gourmet/star gastronomy. Catering & event experience: Ideally, you already have experience in the event catering sector and keep a cool head even in high dynamics. Leadership & organisation: You bring extensive leadership experience, have already led larger teams and independently managed administrative planning and organisation. You have experience in clearly guiding variable employees as reinforcement of the core team during seasonal peaks and ensuring uniform standards. Open personality: You are an inspiring, communicative and winning personality - in short: a real doer who likes to be at the forefront, enthuses their team and does not disappear into the background. Language skills: Very good German and good English skills for smooth communication in the multinational team. Benefits No curfew: With us, you work in continuous shifts instead of fragmented working days. No hours of waiting between shifts - so your free time really remains your time. Company holidays: Two weeks of company holidays in summer as well as two weeks over Christmas and New Year for your recovery are always fixed. Top location & infrastructure: Modern workplace on the dynamic site in Arlesheim directly at the recreational area of the Birs (perfect for breaks by the water). Plenty of parking spaces on site and excellent public transport connections. Strong team spirit: Dynamic environment with flat hierarchies, open informal culture and team events that bond. Ready to help shape the top of our kitchen? Send us your complete application and bring your experience to Ullrich Hospitality!
